rules.statement: A person who can prove they are the trustee is entitled to bring an action for rei vindicatio or declaration of title in respect of trust property against a trespasser, without needing a vesting order first.
rules.supporting_quote: "I do not think, where a power has been expressly given in the Ordinance, we can deny to the parties requiring the exercise of that power some appropriate procedure. In this case, in earlier proceedés, it was held that a mere application to Court was not the proper procedure, but that a regular action was needed. As there was no appeal from that order, for the purposes of this case, that particular point may be regarded as settled."
